arxiv-2102-12032.creator: Kenzo Ishikawa, Kenji Nishiwaki, Kin-ya Oda
arxiv-2102-12032.description: Abstract We report calculations of a wave-packet amplitude of the two-body scattering ϕ ​ ϕ → Φ → ϕ ​ ϕ \phi\phi\to\Phi\to\phi\phi , which leads to the measured probability in realistic experiments. We elucidate the decay amplitude of Φ → ϕ ​ ϕ \Phi\rightarrow\phi\phi from this.

arxiv-2106-10863.title: Chordal graphs, higher independence and vertex decomposable complexes
arxiv-2106-10863.creator: Fred M. Abdelmalek, Priyavrat Deshpande, Shuchita Goyal, Amit Roy, Anurag Singh
arxiv-2106-10863.description: Abstract . Given a finite simple undirected graph G G there is a simplicial complex Ind ⁡ ( G ) \mathrm{Ind}(G) , called the independence complex, whose faces correspond to the independent sets of G G . This is a well studied concept because it provides a fertile ground for interactions between commutative algebra, graph theory and algebraic topology.

arxiv-2204-02490.title: Motion Correction via Locally Linear Embedding for Helical Photon-counting CT
arxiv-2204-02490.creator: Mengzhou Li, Chiara Lowe, Anthony Butler, Phil Butler, and Ge Wang *
arxiv-2204-02490.description: Abstract X-ray photon-counting detector (PCD) offers low noise, high resolution, and spectral characterization, representing a next generation of CT and enabling new biomedical applications. It is well known that involuntary patient motion may induce image artifacts with conventional CT scanning, and this problem becomes more serious with PCD due to its high detector pitch and extended scan time.

arxiv-2204-11717.title: Workhorse minimally-empirical dispersion-corrected density functional, with tests for weakly-bound systems: r 2 SCAN+rVV10
arxiv-2204-11717.creator: Jinliang Ning, Manish Kothakonda, James W. Furness, Aaron D. Kaplan, Sebastian Ehlert, Jan Gerit Brandenburg, John P. Perdew, Jianwei Sun
arxiv-2204-11717.description: Abstract SCAN+rVV10 has been demonstrated to be a versatile van der Waals (vdW) density functional that delivers good predictions of both energetic and structural properties for many types of bonding. Recently, the r 2 SCAN functional has been devised as a revised form of SCAN with improved numerical stability.

arxiv-2212-05469.title: Matrix Approximation with Side Information: When Column Sampling is Enough
arxiv-2212-05469.creator: Jeongmin Chae, Praneeth Narayanamurthy, Selin Bac, Shaama Mallikarjun Sharada, Urbashi Mitra
arxiv-2212-05469.description: Abstract A novel matrix approximation problem is considered herein: observations based on a few fully sampled columns and quasi-polynomial structural side information are exploited. The framework is motivated by quantum chemistry problems wherein full matrix computation is expensive, and partial computations only lead to column information.

arxiv-2308-14993.title: On k k -Mer-Based and Maximum Likelihood Estimation Algorithms for Trace Reconstruction
arxiv-2308-14993.creator: Kuan Cheng, Elena Grigorescu, Xin Li, Madhu Sudan, Minshen Zhu
arxiv-2308-14993.description: Abstract The goal of the trace reconstruction problem is to recover a string 𝐱 ∈ { 0 , 1 } n \mathbf{x}\in\{0,1\}^{n} given many independent traces of 𝐱 \mathbf{x} , where a trace is a subsequence obtained from deleting bits of 𝐱 \mathbf{x} independently with some given probability p ∈ [ 0 , 1 ) . p\in[0,1).

arxiv-2405-10106.title: Advancing Set-Conditional Set Generation: Diffusion Models for Fast Simulation of Reconstructed Particles
arxiv-2405-10106.creator: Dmitrii Kobylianskii, Nathalie Soybelman, Nilotpal Kakati, Etienne Dreyer, Benjamin Nachman, Eilam Gross
arxiv-2405-10106.description: Abstract The computational intensity of detector simulation and event reconstruction poses a significant difficulty for data analysis in collider experiments. This challenge inspires the continued development of machine learning techniques to serve as efficient surrogate models. We propose a fast emulation approach that combines simulation and reconstruction.

arxiv-2407-01151.title: On anti-ample vector bundles and nef and big vector bundles
arxiv-2407-01151.creator: Indranil Biswas, Fatima Laytimi, D. S. Nagaraj, Werner Nahm
arxiv-2407-01151.description:
A 2024 arXiv research paper by Indranil Biswas, Fatima Laytimi, D. S. Nagaraj, Werner Nahm. We prove that the direct image of an anti-ample vector bundle is anti-ample under any finite flat morphism of non-singular projective varieties. In the second part we prove some properties of big and nef vector bundles. In particular it is shown that the tensor product of a nef vector bundle with a nef and big vector bundle is again nef and big. This generalizes a result of Schneider. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification
14F17, 14J60

arxiv-2412-02817.creator: Renzo Cavalieri, Andreas Gross
arxiv-2412-02817.description: Abstract . Under suitable conditions on a family of logarithmic curves, we endow the tropicalization of the family with an affine structure in a neighborhood of the sections in such a way that the tropical ψ \psi classes from [ CGM22 ] arise as tropicalizations of algebraic ψ \psi classes. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification 14T05; 14A20 1.

arxiv-2504-08154.title: Investigating Vision-Language Model for Point Cloud-based Vehicle Classification
arxiv-2504-08154.creator: Yiqiao Li, Jie Wei, Camille Kamga
arxiv-2504-08154.description: Abstract Heavy-duty trucks pose significant safety challenges due to their large size and limited maneuverability compared to passenger vehicles. A deeper understanding of truck characteristics is essential for enhancing the safety perspective of cooperative autonomous driving. Traditional LiDAR-based truck classification methods rely on extensive manual annotations, which makes them labor-intensive and costly.

plos-pone-0005761.creator: Mark T. Romanish, Hisae Nakamura, C. Benjamin Lai et al.
plos-pone-0005761.description: PLOS ONE research article. The human neuronal apoptosis inhibitory protein ( NAIP ) gene is no longer principally considered a member of the Inhibitor of Apoptosis Protein (IAP) family, as its domain structure and functions in innate immunity also warrant inclusion in the Nod-Like Receptor (NLR) superfamil

pmc-10544497.title: B-mode ultrasonography and ARFI elastography of articular and peri-articular structures of the hip joint in non-dysplastic and dysplastic dogs as confirmed by radiographic examination
pmc-10544497.creator: Rafael Kretzer Carneiro, Igor Cezar Kniphoff da Cruz, Beatriz Gasser, Bruna Lima, Luiz Paulo Nogueira Aires, Márcio Poletto Ferreira, Ricardo Andres Ramirez Uscategui, Robson Fortes Giglio, Bruno Watanabe Minto, Marcus Antônio Rossi Feliciano
pmc-10544497.description: BackgroundCanine hip dysplasia is a common orthopedic disease in veterinary practice. The diagnosis is made by radiographic examinations that evaluate bone alterations associated with hip dysplasia. Although radiographic examination is the gold standard for diagnosis, it does not allow a detailed evaluation of soft tissues such as the joint capsule and periarticular muscles.

pmc-10613290.title: Diagnostic accuracy of point-of-care ultrasound with artificial intelligence-assisted assessment of left ventricular ejection fraction
pmc-10613290.creator: Pouya Motazedian, Jeffrey A Marbach, Graeme Prosperi-Porta, Simon Parlow, Pietro Di Santo, Omar Abdel-Razek, Richard Jung, William B Bradford, Miranda Tsang, Michael Hyon, Stefano Pacifici, Sharanya Mohanty, F Daniel Ramirez, Gordon S Huggins, Trevor Simard, Stephanie Hon, Benjamin Hibbert
pmc-10613290.description: Focused cardiac ultrasound (FoCUS) is becoming standard practice in a wide spectrum of clinical settings. There is limited data evaluating the real-world use of FoCUS with artificial intelligence (AI). Our objective was to determine the accuracy of FoCUS AI-assisted left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) assessment and compare its accuracy between novice and experienced users.

pmc-10622917.title: Dynamics of cis-regulatory sequences and transcriptional divergence of duplicated genes in soybean
pmc-10622917.creator: Chao Fang, Mingyu Yang, Yuecheng Tang, Ling Zhang, Hainan Zhao, Hejia Ni, Qingshan Chen, Fanli Meng, Jiming Jiang
pmc-10622917.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). SignificanceWe analyzed the transcriptional regulation of 17,111 pairs of duplicated genes in soybean, which were derived from a whole genome duplication (WGD) that occurred about 5 to 13 Mya. We demonstrate that gain or loss of flanking regulatory sequences and mutation of cis-regulatory elements within the sequences can change the balance of the expression level and/or tissue specificity of duplicated genes.

pmc-11358622.title: How well do large language model-based chatbots perform in oral and maxillofacial radiology?
pmc-11358622.creator: Hui Jeong, Sang-Sun Han, Youngjae Yu, Saejin Kim, Kug Jin Jeon
pmc-11358622.description: ObjectivesThis study evaluated the performance of four large language model (LLM)-based chatbots by comparing their test results with those of dental students on an oral and maxillofacial radiology examination.MethodsChatGPT, ChatGPT Plus, Bard, and Bing Chat were tested on 52 questions from regular dental college examinations.

pmc-11604710.title: Effects of high dietary carbohydrate intake in patients with obstructive sleep apnea
pmc-11604710.creator: Ying Shi, Jun Xu, Shenwen Yi, Chenyu Xu, Fei Yu, Wei Gu, Jing Zhang, Liang Ye
pmc-11604710.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundThis study aimed to characterize the relationship between habitual food intake and OSA.MethodsThe diet of 200 volunteers was evaluated using a Food Frequency Questionnaire. The patients were further allocated to mild, moderate, and severe OSA groups.

pmc-11694056.title: A Digital Approach for Addressing Suicidal Ideation and Behaviors in Youth Mental Health Services: Observational Study
pmc-11694056.creator: Min K Chong, Ian B Hickie, Antonia Ottavio, David Rogers, Gina Dimitropoulos, Haley M LaMonica, Luke J Borgnolo, Sarah McKenna, Elizabeth M Scott, Frank Iorfino, Taiane de Azevedo Cardoso, Varuna Astha, Urjoshi Sinha, Ramin Safa
pmc-11694056.description: BackgroundLong wait times for mental health treatments may cause delays in early detection and management of suicidal ideation and behaviors, which are crucial for effective mental health care and suicide prevention. The use of digital technology is a potential solution for prompt identification of youth with high suicidality.

pmc-12662476.title: Meta-analysis of fluoroquinolone antibiotics in the treatment of pelvic inflammatory disease and associated risk factors
pmc-12662476.creator: Leyi Zhang, Yan Wang
pmc-12662476.description: Pelvic inflammatory disease (PID) is a common infectious disease affecting the female reproductive organs and surrounding tissues. Antibiotics remain a cornerstone of current treatment regimens. This work aimed to systematically assess efficacy of fluoroquinolone antibiotics in the treatment of PID through meta-analysis (MA).

pmc-12709014.title: Caregivers’ perspectives on feline chronic kidney disease in Portugal: a questionnaire-based study
pmc-12709014.creator: Tomás Rodrigues Magalhães, Ana Luísa Lourenço, Ronald Jan Corbee, Inês Guerra, Felisbina Luísa Queiroga
pmc-12709014.description: ObjectivesThe study aimed to assess caregivers’ perspectives on feline chronic kidney disease (CKD).MethodsPeople living in Portugal caring for a cat with CKD were invited to participate in an online questionnaire.ResultsIn total, 405 responses were considered, with most participants (n = 309, 76.3%) dealing with feline CKD for the first time.

pmc-12985870.title: When Assessment Theory Meets Generative AI: Reimagining SBA Design in Medical Education
pmc-12985870.creator: Nora Al-Shawee, Gerry McElvaney, Judith Strawbridge, Muirne Spooner
pmc-12985870.description: Current evaluations of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) in item-writing within medical education often concentrate on isolated dimensions such as validity or reliability, overlooking the broader theoretical foundations that underpin a trustworthy assessment design. This narrow emphasis risks oversimplifying GenAI’s role and obscuring how its adoption reshapes the relationship between quality, efficiency, and educational value.

pmc-13195791.title: Stress granule dynamics orchestrate colitis-to-cancer transition via TOM1-mediated disassembly and driven oncogenesis in response to inflammatory oxidative stress
pmc-13195791.creator: Ziyu Wan, Meirui Qian, Jiawen Yu, Taiyu Shu, Dan Wang, Xue Liang, Ruo Chen, Bo Shi, Hongyong Cui, Zhinan Chen, Jianli Jiang
pmc-13195791.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Colitis-associated colorectal cancer (CAC) is a serious complication of inflammatory bowel disease. As stress-responsive membraneless organelles, stress granules (SGs) are involved in modulating inflammatory suppression and promoting tumorigenesis, but their role in the pathogenesis of CAC remains unclear. This study reveals that SGs exhibit a stage-specific function during CAC progression, being protective in acute colitis but transitioning to a tumor-promoting role in the dysplasia-carcinoma sequence. We first demonstrate that, during acute colitis, fluctuating oxidative stress drives dynamic SGs assembly.

pmc-13212593.title: Intelligent performance prediction of nanoparticle-enhanced automotive radiator cooling using CFD and machine learning
pmc-13212593.creator: Jitendra B Satpute, Dilip Kumar Jang Bahadur Saini, Pooja Sharma, Bipin Kumar Rai, Pravin M Thorat, Gautam Kumar, Kumar Dilip
pmc-13212593.description: Active thermal control of automotive engines is vital for improving performance, robustness and conventional coolants like water and air frequently bring insufficient heat dissipation. To counterpart this ill effect, the propose study examines and investigate the performance enrichment of an automotive radiator using Al₂O₃–ethylene glycol (EG) nanofluids concluded by collective numerical, experimental, and data-driven approach.
